description: This is a unit test file for testing the functionality of an 'OptionalType' template class, including its constructors, assignment, comparison, and value access methods.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: A template class mimicking an optional or nullable type with methods like Clear(), IsSet(), Value(), and operators for comparison and assignment.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the optional object to an unset state.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks whether the optional object currently holds a value.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the stored value, assuming it is set.
